If you want more memory and extensibility, choose Primer 25K. The board also features 8MB of FPGA-gaming-friendly SDRAM memory. Be sure to get the [Tang Nano 20K Retro Gaming Kit](https://www.amazon.com/GW2AR-18-Computer-Debugger-Multiple-Emulator/dp/B0C5XLBQ6C), as it contains the necessary controllers and adapters. 24 25 ## Installation 26 Location #2: verilator/README.md None None 1 This is a Verilator-driven graphical simulation of nestang.
